nodes.label: Teal Chevron Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: A solid upward-pointing chevron in VoM brand teal (#17BAA3) centred on a white square with generous padding; a simplified, legible-at-small-size glyph of the brand used for home-screen icons instead of the full teal script logo.

nodes.label: Next.js apple-icon File Convention
nodes.rationale: Placing apple-icon.png at the app/ root lets the Next.js App Router emit the <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> tag automatically, so no manual head markup is needed.
